"use client"

import { useEffect } from "react"
import { useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form"
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox"
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select"
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"

export interface AdminFormOption { label: string; value: string }
export interface AdminFormFieldDefinition {
  name: string
  label: string
  control: "text" | "email" | "url" | "number" | "checkbox" | "select" | "textarea" | "date" | "datetime-local"
  required: boolean
  description?: string
  minimum?: number
  maximum?: number
  minLength?: number
  maxLength?: number
  pattern?: string
  options?: readonly AdminFormOption[]
}

function validateField(definition: AdminFormFieldDefinition, value: unknown): { message: string } | undefined {
  if (definition.required && (value === undefined || value === null || value === "")) return { message: `${definition.label} is required.` }
  if (typeof value === "string" && definition.minLength !== undefined && value.length < definition.minLength) return { message: `${definition.label} must be at least ${definition.minLength} characters.` }
  if (typeof value === "string" && definition.maxLength !== undefined && value.length > definition.maxLength) return { message: `${definition.label} must be at most ${definition.maxLength} characters.` }
  if (typeof value === "string" && definition.pattern !== undefined && value !== "" && !new RegExp(definition.pattern).test(value)) return { message: `${definition.label} has an invalid format.` }
  if (typeof value === "number" && definition.minimum !== undefined && value < definition.minimum) return { message: `${definition.label} must be at least ${definition.minimum}.` }
  if (typeof value === "number" && definition.maximum !== undefined && value > definition.maximum) return { message: `${definition.label} must be at most ${definition.maximum}.` }
  return undefined
}

export function DynamicForm<TValue extends Record<string, unknown>>({ fields, initialValue, pending, error, success, onSubmit }: {
  fields: readonly AdminFormFieldDefinition[]
  initialValue: TValue
  pending: boolean
  error: Error | null
  success?: boolean
  onSubmit: (value: TValue) => Promise<void>
}) {
  const form = useForm({ defaultValues: initialValue, onSubmit: async ({ value }) => onSubmit(value) })
  useEffect(() => form.reset(initialValue), [form, initialValue])
  return <form className="space-y-6" noValidate onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); void form.handleSubmit() }}>
    <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">{fields.map((definition) => <form.Field key={definition.name} name={definition.name} validators={{ onChange: ({ value }) => validateField(definition, value) }}>{(field) => {
      const invalid = field.state.meta.errors.length > 0
      const common = { id: field.name, name: field.name, onBlur: field.handleBlur, "aria-invalid": invalid }
      // Runtime field schemas are dynamic, so bridge their unknown values to TanStack Form's static DeepValue type here.
      const handleChange = (value: unknown) => field.handleChange(value as never)
      return <Field className={definition.control === "textarea" ? "md:col-span-2" : ""} data-invalid={invalid}><FieldLabel htmlFor={field.name}>{definition.label}{definition.required ? <span className="ml-1 text-destructive" aria-hidden="true">*</span> : null}</FieldLabel>{definition.description ? <FieldDescription>{definition.description}</FieldDescription> : null}{definition.control === "checkbox" ? <Checkbox {...common} checked={Boolean(field.state.value)} onCheckedChange={(checked) => handleChange(checked === true)} /> : definition.control === "select" ? <Select name={field.name} value={String(field.state.value ?? "")} onValueChange={handleChange}><SelectTrigger id={field.name} aria-invalid={invalid}><SelectValue placeholder={`Select ${definition.label}…`} /></SelectTrigger><SelectContent>{definition.options?.map((option) => <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>{option.label}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent></Select> : definition.control === "textarea" ? <Textarea {...common} autoComplete="off" className="min-h-28 resize-y" required={definition.required} minLength={definition.minLength} maxLength={definition.maxLength} value={String(field.state.value ?? "")} onChange={(event) => handleChange(event.target.value)} /> : <Input {...common} autoComplete="off" type={definition.control} required={definition.required} min={definition.minimum} max={definition.maximum} minLength={definition.minLength} maxLength={definition.maxLength} pattern={definition.pattern} value={String(field.state.value ?? "")} onChange={(event) => handleChange(definition.control === "number" ? Number(event.target.value) : event.target.value)} />}{invalid ? <FieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} /> : null}</Field>
    }}</form.Field>)}</div>
    <div aria-live="polite" className="space-y-3">{error ? <Alert variant="destructive"><AlertDescription>{error.message}</AlertDescription></Alert> : null}{success ? <Alert><AlertDescription>Saved successfully.</AlertDescription></Alert> : null}</div>
    <div className="flex items-center justify-end border-t pt-5"><form.Subscribe selector={(state) => [state.canSubmit, state.isSubmitting]}>{([canSubmit, isSubmitting]) => <Button type="submit" disabled={!canSubmit || isSubmitting || pending}>{isSubmitting || pending ? "Saving…" : "Save Changes"}</Button>}</form.Subscribe></div>
  </form>
}
